concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/xdl-lite/requirements.md XDL1-SR-004, realized by XDL1-ARCH-03, XDL1-ARCH-06 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Resolve declared Deployment targets and bindings and preserve the separation of logical identity from physical realization.
Reject an unresolved or unsupported realization without producing a partial plan.
Keep logical identity unchanged when only a declared artifact revision or deployment overlay differs.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
